hero.headline: I build Flutter apps, experiment with machine learning, and enjoy figuring out how things work.
hero.bio: I'm Zyad, a software developer and Data Science student. I've worked on production mobile applications, published Flutter packages, and built independent projects exploring on-device machine learning.

work.title: Selected work
work.subtitle: A selection of production mobile applications I've engineered — spanning offline-first Islamic tools, on-device neural inference, enterprise logistics dispatch, and reactive commerce.

ufuq.title: Ufuq
ufuq.summary: A calm, distraction-free Arabic Islamic companion featuring Holy Quran reading in authentic Uthmani script, live Cairo Quran radio stream, GPS solar prayer times, digital Subha with tactile haptics, and Qibla compass.
ufuq.contribution: I built the mobile application, background audio streaming isolates, sensor-calibrated Qibla magnetometer, and 100% offline Quran reading.
ufuq.h1: 100% Offline Holy Quran reading in authentic Uthmani script
ufuq.h2: Live 24/7 background audio streaming for Cairo Quran Radio
ufuq.h3: Astronomical GPS solar prayer calculations with countdown timer
ufuq.h4: Digital Subha with tactile haptics & daily Athkar repetition tracker
ufuq.mediaLabel: Ufuq Home Screen · Cairo Radio Live & Prayer Times

tashkeel.title: Tashkeel
tashkeel.summary: An on-device Arabic text diacritization mobile application that runs completely offline with zero external data tracking.
tashkeel.contribution: I built the mobile application, integrating the pretrained ShakkalV3 ONNX model to perform 100% offline Arabic diacritization on-device without sending user text to external servers.
tashkeel.h1: 100% On-device neural inference via ONNX Runtime without server requests
tashkeel.h2: Integrated existing ShakkalV3 ONNX pretrained model for contextual diacritization
tashkeel.h3: Single-tap text and .txt file import, processing, and export
tashkeel.h4: Clean Arabic typography with local history and privacy-first storage
tashkeel.mediaLabel: Tashkeel Mobile Interface · On-Device ONNX Diacritization

wofoodi.title: Wofoodi
wofoodi.summary: A real-time fuel station discovery and regional pricing application built for motorists across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
wofoodi.contribution: I worked on the Flutter mobile application, focusing on the geospatial station map, location-based filtering, and local caching layer.
wofoodi.h3: Local SQLite caching for low-connectivity sectors
wofoodi.h4: REST API integration with backend services

amoomy.title: Amoomy
amoomy.summary: A mobile coordination platform for heavy freight, vehicle towing, and construction equipment transport across Saudi Arabia.
amoomy.contribution: I worked on the Flutter application and its multi-role experience for shippers and heavy truck haulers.
amoomy.h1: Role-based application flows for clients and haulers
amoomy.h3: User and operational quotation negotiation workflows
amoomy.h4: Offline-safe state handling in remote transit corridors

raval.title: Raval
raval.summary: A fashion e-commerce mobile application with rapid catalog exploration and step-by-step order tracking.
raval.contribution: I worked on the mobile shopping experience, reactive stateful shopping cart calculations, disk-cached image loader, and checkout flow.
raval.h1: Product catalog browsing and category filtering

payss.title: Payss
payss.summary: A merchant-focused application involving QR scanning and loyalty functionality.
payss.contribution: I worked on Flutter application features related to merchant interactions, camera QR scanning, and activity ledgers.
payss.h1: QR code scanning for fast customer verification
payss.h4: Clean interface for daily counter workflows

thingsIveBuilt.title: Things I've built
thingsIveBuilt.subtitle: Projects that started with a technical question, an interesting problem, or something I wanted to understand better — spanning open-source packages, systems tools, and applied computer vision.

liquidNavbar.title: Liquid Navbar
liquidNavbar.summary: A physics-based fluid navigation bar component package published on pub.dev. Engineered strictly with native Flutter CustomPainter and cubic bezier matrix math for 60fps spring transitions without heavy external dependencies.
liquidNavbar.contribution: Author & package maintainer. Implemented bezier wave calculations, spring damping physics, and responsive theme adaptation.
liquidNavbar.h4: Tested across iOS, Android, macOS, and Web
liquidNavbar.testWave: Tap any icon to test the liquid spring glide animation.

boa.title: Boa
boa.summary: An open-source terminal compression toolkit and file explorer. Built in Go, with support for streaming multi-threaded Zstandard and DEFLATE compression, safe extraction with Zip-Slip path traversal protection, archive inspection, and performance benchmarking.
boa.contribution: Author. Architected concurrent streaming pipelines, Bubble Tea terminal interactive browser, and path traversal vulnerability defenses.

offlineQuran.title: Offline Quran Recognition
offlineQuran.summary: An independent research prototype exploring edge-device offline speech recognition for Quranic recitations without server reliance.
offlineQuran.contribution: Independent researcher. Evaluated acoustic Mel spectrogram feature extraction and lightweight CTC acoustic models aligned against standardized Uthmani script text under mobile memory constraints.
offlineQuran.h1: Edge Mel spectrogram & MFCC feature extraction
offlineQuran.h3: Uthmani text alignment with phoneme matching
offlineQuran.step1Desc: 16kHz sampling, noise reduction, and Mel spectrogram / MFCC feature extraction.
offlineQuran.step2Desc: Character probability matrices evaluated across temporal speech frames.
offlineQuran.step3Desc: Phoneme matching against standardized Quranic verse indices in local SQLite cache.
offlineQuran.researchFocusText: Overcoming Tajweed recitation acoustic variations (Ghunnah, Madd elongation) within strict mobile RAM constraints.

aslDetection.title: Real-Time ASL Alphabet Recognition
aslDetection.summary: A real-time computer vision pipeline utilizing MediaPipe hand tracking (21 3D landmarks) and a deep neural classifier to detect and translate 26 American Sign Language finger gestures in real time via standard webcam.
aslDetection.contribution: Author & ML engineer. Designed hand coordinate normalization, landmark vectorization, and inference pipeline running at 30+ FPS on commodity hardware.
aslDetection.h4: Published research writeup on Medium / Stackademic

about.title: A little about me
about.p1: I'm a Data Science student who started building Flutter applications and gradually became interested in the engineering behind them.
about.p2: Outside mobile development, I enjoy exploring machine learning, algorithms, computer vision, and building tools that solve problems I encounter.
about.p3: I like understanding how things work, experimenting with unfamiliar technologies, and sharing what I learn along the way.
about.educationDesc: Focusing on statistical modeling, algorithms, and practical machine learning applications.
about.communityDesc: Flutter Committee mentor, sharing Clean Architecture patterns and state management practices.
about.focus1Desc: Building production Flutter applications with Clean Architecture, dependable state handling, and offline caching.
about.focus2Desc: Exploring lightweight model deployment with ONNX Runtime, OpenCV pipelines, and edge inference.
about.focus3Desc: Writing clear technical breakdowns of real engineering patterns rather than buzzword tutorials.
